correctness.rationale: For all integers k≥2,u≥1 and B>0, λ2 is the concave Rayleigh minimum, so averaging arbitrary edge weights over graph automorphisms preserves global optimality. The four Laplacian invariant pieces are exhausted and give λ2=min{μ_-, ka+ud+kb}, where μ_- is the smaller root of μ²−(nd+2kb)μ+2k²bd=0 and is strictly below kd. To attain λ>0 with kd=λ(1+t), the least cross weight b0=λ[((n/k)(1+t)−1)]/(2kt); replacing any excess cross weight with an equal increase in within-gateway a reduces budget, proving the exact F(t) budget formula. The involution t↦1/(2t) and the derivative of its active branch establish a unique three-regime minimizer. Symmetry averaging and nonnegativity extend the forced-zero and positive-total support statements to every asymmetric optimum. `VERIFY.py` passed 189 full-eigenvalue/budget graph cases and 2430 unrestricted asymmetric samples, plus symbolic reduced characteristic and differentiation identities. Finite tests do not prove all-parameter assertions; the analytic proof does.

originality.rationale: The exact joint intra- and interlayer conductance-budget optimum, its three k/u phases, and universally forced edge-class deletion were not found in inspected overlapping literature. The 2006 general convex/symmetry framework yields methods and bounds but does not state this formula. The 2015 and 2024 multilayer sources hold within-layer weights fixed and optimize the cross-layer system; their claims do not imply jointly optimal intralayer support. The closely related matching-gateway calculation concerns only k cross edges and cannot dominate the complete k²-edge gateway: at k=5,u=2, unit budget, this result gives 2/23 versus about 0.0769326244 for the matching graph, with opposite within-gateway support. Search limitations remain.

value.rationale: Two fully connected communities joined through a limited all-to-all gateway are a standard structural motif for consensus and diffusion design. The exact global optimum simultaneously prices internal clique links and cross links; it gives three genuinely different analytic regimes separated by two explicit thresholds, including mandatory deletion of entire edge orbits by every optimizer and a sharp reversal to strictly positive aggregate within-gateway spending. At k=7,u=1 and k=8,u=1 the structure changes, so the thresholds are realized in the natural integer domain. Strict comparison with the matching-only gateway at k=5,u=2 establishes that the complete gateway changes both the exact optimum and the support policy, rather than producing a routine parameter substitution.
